callback_gas_limit.description: Gas limit on each nois callback submessage. Default 500_000.

prices.description: Accepted fees. Empty or omitted means requests are free (funds are still accepted).

pubkey.description: Compressed drand group public key. 48 bytes for chained, 96 bytes for quicknet.

required_attestations.description: Attestations required before a round can be delivered. Default 0 (drand only).

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_hex_binary_HexBinary
definitions.description:
This is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add hex de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is similar to `cosmwasm_std::Binary` but uses hex.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

add_round.description:
Verify a drand beacon and store `sha256(signature)` as the round randomness.

`previous_signature` is required for [`DrandScheme::PedersenBlsChained`]
unless round-1 is already stored. It must be omitted for quicknet.

attest.description:
Attest a stored drand round. The signer must be a registered attestor.

Message is documented in the crate README and [`crate::attestor`].

process_queue.description: Deliver up to the per-tx callback batch. Permissionless.

provide.description:
Pull entrypoint for `nftfi-raffle` (`RandomnessSourceMsg::Callback`).

The sender is the raffle contract. The beacon reads raffle `raffle_id`
from the sender, takes the first drand round published strictly after
the raffle end (`start + duration`), and answers with the attributes
the raffle reply reads: `raffle_id`, `round`, `randomness` (base64,
32 bytes) and `owner`. Fails when that round is not stored or not yet
deliverable under `required_attestations`.

prices.description: `Some` replaces the price list. An empty list makes requests free.

amount.description: Omit to withdraw the full balance of `denom`.

definitions.name: terp_beacon_source_BeaconSource
definitions.description:
Where a beacon value came from.

Verified drand outputs are stored under [`BeaconSource::Drand`].
Attestor signatures over a drand output are stored under [`BeaconSource::Attestor`].
Both are keyed by source id plus round (attestations also include the attestor key).

[`RESERVED_IBC_SOURCE_ID`] is the id a future IBC v2 client should use when a
hash-market runtime starts aggregating beacons. That client should verify the
packet, then write the same [`crate::state::StoredBeacon`] record the drand
path writes. There is no IBC entry point in this contract.
